cards.body: Simulation, which has long been the proving ground for robots learning to walk, roll and hop, is now helping researchers teach robots tasks that require a finer touch: aligning gears, connecting cables and assembling small components. The shift from locomotion to manipulation is taking center stage at this week’s Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL) in Austin, Texas, alongside the rise of agentic robotics — a new paradigm that integrates frontier agents to create interpretable code for physical robotics systems. At CoRL, NVIDIA is introducing new open robotics technologies, including world action models , simulation tools, benchmarks and agentic workflows. Two NVIDIA papers are among six finalists out of thousands of submissions for the Best Paper Awards at CoRL: GRAIL (Generating Humanoid Loco-Manipulation from World Models), which presents a digital generation pipeline for 3D assets and simulator-ready scenes for robot learning. RoboTTT: Context Scaling for Robot Policies , which introduces a robot model and training recipe that scales visuomotor context three orders of magnitude beyond state-of-the-art policies without growing inference latency. These advancements help researchers train robots on complex tasks, evaluate their performance across changing conditions and use failures to guide further learning — building the precision, adaptability and autonomy needed to move from lab demonstrations to industrial deployment. NVIDIA is working with partners like Ambi Robotics , Bosch Research , Dexmate , Dyna Robotics , FieldAI , Flexion , Noitom Robotics , Siemens , Skild AI , RLWRLD , UC Berkeley , Walden Robotics and the University of Washington to bring these advancements to the broader robotics community. World Action Models Enable Next Level of Robot Autonomy The next level of robot autonomy requires robots to perceive their surroundings, anticipate how their actions will change the environment and execute complex, multistep tasks with a high degree of precision. World action models enable exactly that. At CoRL, NVIDIA is introducing GR00T 2 , an open frontier world action model built on NVIDIA Cosmos. Trained on diverse robot and human data, including 100,000 hours of NVIDIA open source human egocentric data , the model enables robots to learn dexterous manipulation skills. Key features include: Out-of-the-box performance: Completed 40 of 50 evaluated tasks at least once without task-specific demonstrations. Skill transfer: Learns from human demonstrations and transfers skills between different robot bodies without robot demonstrations Generalization with little data: Achieved 71% average success across 50 tasks with just one demonstration per task, increasing to 95% with five. Korea Advances Physical AI Across Industries With NVIDIA

cards.body: Tapping into the country’s strengths in manufacturing and engineering, NVIDIA is helping advance Korea’s physical AI ecosystem. The country’s industry leaders are applying accelerated computing, AI and simulation to everything from semiconductor manufacturing to robotics and autonomous vehicles. These efforts are helping bring physical AI from development into real-world production. Samsung Advances Semiconductor Engineering With Accelerated Computing and AI Physics Samsung Electronics is expanding its collaboration with NVIDIA to advance semiconductor innovation through accelerated computing and AI physics. The work spans materials research, process development and device engineering. In technology computer-aided design, Samsung is working with NVIDIA cuISS and NVIDIA cuDSS to accelerate computations involving sparse linear systems. The collaboration also extends to GPU acceleration for process and optical simulations. In materials research, Samsung’s sMOL platform has run selected quantum chemical calculations up to 5x faster end to end with NVIDIA cuEST . Samsung is also exploring NVIDIA cuEquivariance to speed up tensor operations used in training and inference for atomistic AI models. Samsung is developing chip-scale thermal and mechanical analysis workflows with NVIDIA PhysicsNeMo . In one AI homogenization case, combining AI-predicted effective material properties, coarser grids and GPU acceleration resulted in a roughly 1,600x speedup. Simulation time fell from about 18 hours for a fine-grid solve on a 32-core CPU to 41 seconds for a GPU-accelerated coarse-grid solve. Looking ahead, NVIDIA Agent Toolkit could connect these simulation tools and AI models, helping future engineering agents run analyses and compare design options. Kakao Mobility Collaborates With NVIDIA to Advance Autonomous Driving Development Kakao Mobility plans to build on NVIDIA’s autonomous vehicle computing and safety technologies to advance development of a level 4 autonomous driving system. The work combines Kakao Mobility’s proprietary driving software and experience operating in Seoul’s Gangnam district with NVIDIA’s vehicle computing platform. Kakao Mobility plans to use NVIDIA Hyperion , a reference platform for vehicle sensors and compute, powered by NVIDIA DRIVE AGX Thor. It also plans to use NVIDIA Halos to support safety across the development and validation of its autonomous driving technology. Initial development is planned around Kia purpose-built vehicles, integrating Kakao Mobility’s autonomous driving software with NVIDIA technologies. The effort aims to support future level 4 mobility services in Korea. LG Electronics Advances Robot Learning and Factory Simulation NVIDIA and LG Electronics successfully demonstrated NVIDIA Isaac GR00T-powered robotic manipulation and manufacturing tasks using LG’s CLOiD robot in an actual manufacturing environment. cards.body: NVIDIA and Korea’s Ministry of Science and ICT (MSIT) are expanding their collaboration across the country’s sovereign AI ecosystem, from AI semiconductors and data center infrastructure to talent, startups, models, agents and security. The collaboration lays the groundwork for Korean NPU and XPU companies to explore participation in the NVIDIA NVLink Fusion ecosystem, and includes NVIDIA training and certification programs, hackathons and technical seminars to strengthen GPU utilization. Through Korea’s AI for All initiative, NVIDIA will collaborate with three selected consortia and four leading Korean foundation model builders, using NVIDIA Dynamo software to optimize and scale AI inference. In addition, NVIDIA today announced a collaboration with SK Telecom and Rebellions, supported by MSIT, to advance sovereign AI infrastructure for Korean models and workloads with NVIDIA NVLink Fusion. Read more in the press release .

cards.body: Nvidia-based compute is getting scarce and expensive for Chinese AI labs on both of their main routes, buying export-compliant cards and renting abroad, and the Financial Times reports that Nvidia’s own crackdowns are part of the reason. Nvidia has told cloud partners worldwide that at least 51% of their services must go to non-Chinese firms, while Chinese companies have bought more than 1 million Nvidia gaming and workstation cards this year to cover the shortfall. Meanwhile, a B300 rack that sells for about $600,000 internationally reportedly fetched $2.8 million in China last month. Chinese customers have ordered more than 6 million of Nvidia’s export-compliant RTX Pro 5500 cards. That is at least twice the 3 million that the company could reportedly manufacture in 2027. One source told CNBC that it was proposed that Moonshot pay 30% to 50% more upfront, in comparison to a non-Chinese entity. Many Chinese groups have relied on overseas leases for advanced AI work, which can include model training, and these tech groups have been the biggest clients for data centers in Southeast Asia. Data centers unable to find non-Chinese clients could be forced to pull back supply, and it’s “difficult to find enough non-Chinese clients outside the US,” one Singapore-based group told the FT . While Nvidia hasn’t confirmed or denied its new rule, implementing it would ease criticism from U.S. lawmakers just as Chinese demand is growing. What Nvidia told partners has come through verbal instructions, via sales and regional teams, and applies globally rather than just in Asia. Existing deals and leases are not changed, but new ones must comply. Nvidia’s whitelist more than halved its authorized Asian buyer count, which encouraged more Chinese groups to lease over other options, including smuggling. On top of this, Fleet Intelligence tracking is now required for Southeast Asian providers that want to become Nvidia Cloud Partners. All of these combined — whitelist, cap, and tracking — may act to alleviate U.S. concerns. Among companies that have moved to renting, Moonshot has held discussions to rent capacity from neoclouds that host in Europe with Nvidia GPUs. Specifically, it’s looking for Nvidia Blackwell systems, which export controls bar from China; one source said the talks covered clusters of 8,000 or more Blackwell GPUs in Europe. These clusters would handle inference, serving models to end users, and the European talks for them happened after the White House said Moonshot accessed Blackwell chips through a facility in Thailand . The firm has been fervent about its intentions to secure more compute. Moonshot isn't the only Chinese company looking to secure Nvidia chips for AI training. Tencent has a deal with Oracle to lease 100,000 GPUs in Southeast Asian data centers. headlines.body: As AI agents take on more work, they need capable open models and security that advances alongside them. Hyundai Motor Group is exploring NVIDIA NemoClaw blueprints and the NVIDIA OpenShell runtime, while AIM Intelligence is integrating its Starfort platform with NVIDIA OpenShell to support secure AI agents for employee productivity and enterprise workflows . A key component of the NVIDIA Open Agent Safety Platform, OpenShell provides a secure runtime with sandboxed execution and policy-based controls to safeguard sensitive data, manage access to enterprise tools and govern autonomous agent actions. AIM Intelligence , a Korean AI security company, is integrating its Starfort agent control platform with NVIDIA OpenShell. The goal is to combine OpenShell’s runtime access controls with Starfort’s detection of malicious instructions and data leakage. The company is also considering a preliminary proof of concept for the public energy sector, with potential applications across enterprise, industrial and robotics environments. On the model side, LG AI Research is opening application programming interface access for K-EXAONE-2.5, developed using NVIDIA Nemotron datasets, including Nemotron-Personas-Korea . Nemotron-Personas-Korea is an open dataset of 7 million fully synthetic Korean personas, grounded in official Korean statistics, that model builders use to ground training data and evaluation in Korean contexts. NVIDIA Nemotron is a family of open models, datasets and techniques that help developers build specialized, efficient AI agents. Learn more about NVIDIA Nemotron open models and get started building secure agents with NVIDIA OpenShell .

headlines.body: AI 추천 뉴스 엔비디아, 韓 AI 스타트업에 대규모 투자 포인트투테크엔 첫 자금 투입 업스테이지·리얼월드 등도 포함 엔비디아가 최고경영자(CEO) 스캔들에 휘말린 가운데서도 한국 인공지능(AI) 스타트업에 잇달아 투자하며 한국 기업과의 협력을 강화하고 있다. 엔비디아는 9일 과학기술정보통신부와 서울 삼성동 코엑스에서 연 ‘AI 스타트업 파트너십 포럼’에서 포인트투테크놀로지에 신규 투자하고 모티프테크놀로지스, 업스테이지, 리얼월드 등에도 추가로 투자한다고 밝혔다. 포인트투테크놀로지는 AI 데이터센터에서 반도체와 서버 간 데이터를 전송하는 무선주파수(RF) 기반 연결 기술을 개발하는 기업이다. 기존 구리선과 광케이블을 대체할 차세대 AI 인프라 기술을 확보하고 있다. AI 모델 개발사 모티프는 엔비디아의 투자를 바탕으로 차세대 대규모언어모델(LLM) ‘모티프 4’ 개발에 나선다. 업스테이지는 진행 중인 시리즈C 2차 투자 라운드에서 엔비디아의 투자를 받아 자체 AI 모델 ‘솔라’ 고도화에 활용한다. 피지컬 AI 기업 리얼월드는 엔비디아와 공동 개발한 로봇 정밀 손 조작 평가 도구 ‘덱스벤치’를 이날 공개했다. 엔비디아는 이날 SK텔레콤, 리벨리온과는 소버린 AI 인프라를 구축하기 위한 업무협약(MOU)을 맺었다. 엔비디아의 그래픽처리장치(GPU)와 리벨리온의 신경망처리장치(NPU)를 결합한 AI 데이터센터 인프라를 개발하는 게 핵심이다. 국내 대기업과의 기술 협력도 확대한다. 삼성전자는 엔비디아의 AI 시뮬레이션 기술 ‘피직스네모’ 등을 반도체 설계와 공정 개발에 활용하고 있다. LG전자는 엔비디아의 로봇 AI 모델 ‘아이작 그루트’ 등을 이용해 자체 로봇 ‘클로이드’를 고도화한다. LG AI연구원은 자체 개발한 AI 모델 ‘K-엑사원’의 추론 처리 효율을 높이기 위해 엔비디아의 ‘다이나모’ 기술을 적용하는 방안을 검토하고 있다. 카카오모빌리티는 엔비디아의 차량용 AI 반도체 등을 활용해 레벨4 완전자율주행 기술 개발을 추진한다. 라현진 기자 raraland@hankyung.com

key_facts: 젠슨 황 CEO가 11월 8일(현지시간) 직원 이메일로 불륜 사실을 인정했고, 상대는 **중국 정보기관 연계 의혹을 받는 싱가포르 데이터센터 업체 전 임원**
이 사건으로 매디슨 황(옴니버스·로보틱스 제품 마케팅 수석이사)의 9~10일 방한 일정이 전면 취소되어 카카오모빌리티 포토세션, 리벨리온 본사 방문, 과기정통부 부총리 면담 등이 무산됨
NVIDIA, SK Telecom, Rebellions는 리벨리온의 차세대 NPU '리벨 R200'을 **NVLink Fusion**으로 NVIDIA GPU와 연결하는 MOU를 체결, SK텔레콤 데이터센터에 구축 예정
NVIDIA는 두산로보틱스(로봇 시뮬레이션), 현대자동차(공장 디지털 트윈), LG전자(로봇 클로이 작업 학습·검증) 등과 피지컬 AI 협력을 진행 중

summary_data.why_matters: 경영진 스캔들이라는 리스크 요인에도 **NVIDIA의 한국 소버린 AI·피지컬 AI 협력 일정이 차질 없이 진행**된 것은 회사 차원의 생태계 전략이 개인 이슈와 분리되어 운영됨을 보여준다. 특히 NVLink Fusion을 통한 리벨리온 NPU 연동은 NVIDIA가 자국산 반도체와의 상호운용성을 확대하며 자사 플랫폼 중심의 AI 인프라 표준화를 추진하는 사례로 의미가 크다.
summary_data.subject_angle: NVIDIA는 **NVLink Fusion을 매개로 경쟁·보완 관계의 로컬 NPU(Rebellions)까지 자사 생태계에 편입**시켜 글로벌 AI 연산 표준 주도권을 유지하려는 전략을 보이며, 동시에 두산로보틱스·현대자동차·LG전자 등과의 피지컬 AI 협력으로 로보틱스·자율주행 영역 확장을 지속하고 있다.
summary_data.focus_angle: 현대자동차와의 공장 디지털 트윈 협력, 두산로보틱스와의 로봇 시뮬레이션 협력은 **NVIDIA Omniverse 기반 피지컬 AI 플랫폼이 제조·로보틱스 현장에 실질적으로 적용**되고 있음을 보여주며, 한국 제조업의 인력 부족 문제 해법으로 범용 로봇 AI 에이전트 필요성이 공식 언급된 점은 휴머노이드·산업용 로봇 수요 확대 신호로 해석된다.

headlines.body: 젠슨 황 엔비디아 최고경영자(CEO)가 불륜 사실을 인정한 가운데 장녀 매디슨 황 수석이사의 한국 방문이 취소됐다. 매디슨 황은 9일 서울에서 열린 '엔비디아 AI 데이'에 참석하고 국내 기업과의 업무협약 체결을 위해 방한할 예정이었다. 매디슨 황의 불참에도 엔비디아는 국내 기업들과 예정된 업무협약을 체결하고 행사를 정상적으로 치뤘다. 엔비디아는 9일 서울 코엑스에서 '엔비디아 AI 데이 서울 2026' 행사를 개최했다. 행사는 정소영 엔비디아 코리아 엔터프라이즈 세일즈 총괄 대표의 개회사로 시작했다. 엔비디아는 피지컬 AI와 AI 인프라 전략, 국내 기업과의 협력 사례를 소개했다. 당초 행사에는 황 CEO의 장녀인 매디슨 황 엔비디아 옴니버스·로보틱스 제품 마케팅 수석이사가 참석할 예정이었다. 그러나 엔비디아 측은 지난 주말 내부 사정을 이유로 매디슨 황의 9~10일 방한 일정이 전면 취소됐다고 통보했다. 매디슨 황이 참석할 예정이었던 카카오모빌리티 포토세션과 언론 질의응답, 리벨리온 본사 방문 및 경영진 만찬 등이 무산됐다. 배경훈 과학기술정보통신부 부총리 겸 장관과의 면담도 취소됐다. 배 부총리도 이날 행사에 참석하지 않았다. 황 CEO는 8일(현지시간) 직원들에게 보낸 이메일에서 불륜 사실을 인정했다. 상대는 중국 정보기관과 연계된 의혹을 받는 싱가포르 데이터센터 업체 전 임원이다. 엔비디아 이사회는 같은 날 독립조사에 착수할 것임을 발표했다. 매디슨 황의 방한 취소 통보는 그 직후 나왔다. 이날 오후 과기정통부와 엔비디아는 한국 소버린 AI 인프라 발전을 위해 협력할 것임을 공식 발표했다. 엔비디아와 SK텔레콤, 리벨리온은 국산 신경망처리장치(NPU)를 엔비디아의 AI 연산 플랫폼과 연결하는 내용의 업무협약(MOU)을 체결했다. 핵심은 리벨리온의 차세대 신경망처리장치(NPU) '리벨 R200'과 엔비디아 그래픽처리장치(GPU)를 하나의 시스템으로 연결하는 것이다. 두 반도체를 연결하는 데는 엔비디아의 고속 인터커넥트 기술인 NV링크 퓨전을 활용한다. SK텔레콤은 이를 적용한 AI 시스템을 자사 데이터센터에 구축할 계획이다. 제시 클레이튼 엔비디아 AI 인프라 제품 마케팅 매니저는 "리벨리온의 차세대 NPU 리벨 R200을 NV링크 퓨전으로 엔비디아 AI 연산 플랫폼에 연결할 것"이라며 "해당 NPU 시스템과 엔비디아 GPU 시스템을 SK텔레콤의 AI 데이터센터에 구축한다"고 밝혔다. 박성현 리벨리온 대표는 "볼트, 나사, 운영체제(OS) 등 100% 모든 요소를 국산화하는 접근은 스케일 확장성과 시장 출시 속도 면에서 현실적이지 않다"며 "리벨리온의 NPU 기술력과 엔비디아 생태계, SK텔레콤의 운영 능력을 결합해 소버린 AI 연산 표준을 정립하는 것이 협력의 핵심 목적"이라고 말했다. 리벨리온은 국내에서 연산 규격과 토큰 API를 안착시킨 뒤 글로벌 시장으로 확대한다는 구상이다. 이도규 과기정통부 정보통신정책실장은 "한국이 개발한 국산 AI 반도체를 글로벌 AI 생태계와 연결하고 세계 시장에서 경쟁할 수 있는 기반을 마련했다"고 평가했다. 이날 협약 서명식에는 매디슨 황을 대신해 아쉬시 카란디카 엔비디아 NV링크 퓨전 부사장이 참석했다. 카카오모빌리티와의 업무협약도 엔비디아의 다른 임원이 참석한 가운데 예정대로 진행됐다. 오전 기술 발표에서는 한국 기업들과의 피지컬 AI 협력 사례가 소개됐다. 디푸 탈라 엔비디아 로보틱스·엣지 AI 부문 부사장은 한국의 제조업 경쟁력과 인력 부족 문제를 언급하며 범용 로봇용 AI 에이전트의 필요성을 강조했다. 엔비디아는 두산로보틱스와 로봇 시뮬레이션, 현대자동차와 공장 디지털 트윈 구축, LG전자와 로봇 클로이의 작업 학습 및 검증 분야에서 협력하고 있다. SK텔레콤과는 AI 팩토리 구축, SK하이닉스와는 자율형 반도체 팹의 사전 검증(PoC)을 추진하고 있다. 조나단 코헨 엔비디아 응용연구 부문 부사장은 KT, SK텔레콤, LG AI연구원 등이 엔비디아 네모트론 기술과 데이터셋을 활용해 한국 특화 AI 모델을 개발하고 있다고 소개했다. 엔비디아는 국내 기업들과 에이전틱 AI 서비스 및 플랫폼 구축 협력도 확대하고 있다. 한편 엔비디아는 이날 젠슨 황 CEO의 불륜 사건에 대해서는 언급하지 않았다. 오후 협약 서명식 이후 취재진이 관련 질문을 했으나 엔비디아 측은 답변하지 않았다.

headlines.body: Korea’s Ministry of Science and ICT and NVIDIA hosted the MSIT -NVIDIA AI Startup Partnership Forum at COEX. Representatives from the Ministry of Science and ICT and NVIDIA met with over 20 Korean startups across foundation models, physical AI, AI infrastructure and AI semiconductors. NVIDIA also announced an investment in Korean startup Point2 , with additional investments planned in Motif Technologies , RLWRLD and Upstage. Point2 Technology, an AI interconnect company, builds scalable, radio frequency-based interconnects that move data between chips and racks in AI factories, offering an innovative alternative to conventional copper and optical interconnect solutions for AI cluster scale-up, delivering the reach, performance and efficiency needed for next-generation AI infrastructure. Motif Technologies , a Seoul-based AI lab, develops foundation models for building AI agents that carry out complex tasks, including Motif-3, a large language model released with open weights. RLWRLD, a physical AI startup based in San Francisco, Seoul and Tokyo, develops robotics foundation models that enable humanoid and industrial robots to perform complex real-world tasks that require five-finger dexterity, such as precisely inserting components, threading nuts onto bolts and kitting parts from moving conveyors. Upstage , a Korean enterprise AI company, develops Solar language models and document AI tools that help businesses extract information from complex documents, streamline workflows and build AI applications for everyday operations. The companies represent work across the full AI stack , from infrastructure to models to robotics applications. The planned investments build on NVIDIA’s work with Korea’s startup and venture community, including more than 1,000 Korea-based members of NVIDIA Inception , a program that helps startups grow with access to preferred pricing, technical expertise and opportunities for investor introductions.

As models grow beyond the capacity of a single GPU, they must be split across multiple GPUs, requiring careful coordination of request routing and communication to maintain performance. NVIDIA Dynamo is an open source, distributed inference-serving framework built to deploy models in multi-node environments at data center scale. It handles this routing and communication to maximize inference performance. Optimized for NVIDIA B200 GPUs, these recipes take the guesswork out of deployment, delivering up to 2x performance out of the box. headlines.body: Nvidia is reportedly looking to deploy GPU capacity at the central offices of US Internet service provider Brightspeed. The Information reports that Nvidia has pitched Apollo Global Management, Brightspeed’s parent company, the idea of using legacy central offices as potential Edge compute nodes for a new inference network. According to the publication, the companies are currently sharing information and arranging potential site visits. The telecommunications company has around 130 buildings across the US. The Information reports that these sites could reportedly host up to 1GW of GPU compute capacity, though this would require significant power and cooling infrastructure upgrades, and possibly permit changes. The first capacity at the retrofitted buildings could reportedly go live as soon as Q1 2027. The sites would also include hardware from Groq, the AI chip startup Nvidia has a major technology license with. Brightspeed was founded in 2021, with Apollo Global acquiring Lumen’s incumbent local exchange carrier (ILEC) business in 20 states and beginning a program to update the copper network to fiber. Brightspeed has been looking to sell off a number of its data center sites in leaseback deals across the US. In recent years, the company has put facilities up for sale in Arkansas, Virginia, Missouri, and Ohio. End of copper, start of AI for central offices? As incumbent telecoms operators globally look to decommission their copper-based networks, many are looking at what to do with their footprint of central offices (aka telephone exchanges). Fiber networks require fewer connection hubs than copper networks, and these increasingly idle legacy sites can offer potential reuse opportunities for operators. Some telecoms operators are simply exiting the facilities entirely and leaving the ones in inner-city locations to be redeveloped for accommodation. Others, including Telefónica and Ziply, are looking to upgrade and repurpose them for Edge colocation purposes. While central offices often offer high redundancy and low-latency locations, these legacy facilities are also extremely old, very low-density, and not designed for AC power, meaning they require significant upgrade work to accommodate modern IT gear. Many operators have also already sold off ownership of these sites in sale-leaseback deals to fuel network growth initiatives. The news comes at a difficult time for both companies. Brightspeed recently appointed a new CEO amid reports that the firm is close to bankruptcy, while Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has been embroiled in an affair scandal involving a potential Chinese spy.

**엔비디아는 2024년부터 제품 발표 주기를 2년에서 1년으로 단축**했으며 아마존·MS도 자체 칩을 1년 주기로 출시 중

headlines.body: AI 추천 뉴스 엔비디아 흔든 구글 TPU, 출시 7개월만에 신제품 2종 공개 8tx는 기밀 보호…8i Max는 연산 능력 2배 기존 칩에 메모리·통신망 조합해 개발 기간 단축 로메이어 “자체 서비스로 새 수요 먼저 파악” 클라우드 매출 103%↑…전체 매출 비중 24.1% 구글이 기업의 기밀 정보를 하드웨어 차원에서 보호하는 신형 인공지능(AI) 칩을 공개했다. 자체 AI칩 ‘텐서처리장치(TPU)’ 8세대 제품을 공개한 지 약 7개월 만이다. 구글은 9일(현지시간) ‘TPU 8tx’와 ‘TPU 8i Max’를 발표했다. 지난 4월 공개한 학습용 칩 ‘8t’와 추론용 칩 ‘8i’를 바탕으로 제품군을 네 종류로 늘렸다. TPU는 AI 모델 연산에 최적화된 구글의 자체 반도체다. 8tx는 기존 학습용 8t 칩에 보안 기능을 더했다. 기밀 컴퓨팅을 지원하는 AMD 중앙처리장치(CPU)를 결합하고 데이터 처리 공간을 하드웨어로 격리해 AI가 연산하는 동안에도 기업 정보와 AI모델의 핵심 정보인 가중치를 보호하도록 했다. 작업 메모리를 암호화하고 접근을 제한하는 방식이다. 규제가 엄격한 기업과 정부기관이 주요 고객이다. 8i Max는 기존 8i 칩 두 개를 하나의 패키지로 묶은 제품이다. 연산 능력을 두 배로 늘리고 고대역폭메모리(HBM) 용량을 33% 확대한 384기가바이트(GB)로 키웠다. 메모리와 데이터를 주고받는 속도도 두 배인 초당 17.2테라바이트(TB)로 높였다. 보안과 메모리를 강화한 것은 사람 대신 업무를 처리하는 AI 에이전트 수요에 대응하기 위해서다. 에이전트가 기업 이메일과 내부 문서를 읽는 과정에서 기밀정보를 지키고, 방대한 자료를 동시에 분석할 수 있도록 하는 데 초점을 맞췄다. 구글이 7개월 만에 신제품을 내놓은 비결은 ‘모듈화’다. 기존 TPU 칩을 공통 부품으로 활용하면서 패키징 방식이나 주변 메모리·네트워크·보안 부품을 바꿀 수 있도록 했다. 아민 바닷 구글 AI·인프라 수석부사장은 “이를 통해 특화 슈퍼컴퓨터를 수년이 아닌 수개월 안에 제공할 수 있다”고 설명했다. 새 AI 모델이 수개월마다 출시되는 흐름과 맞물려 반도체 업계에서도 속도 경쟁이 벌어지고 있다. 엔비디아는 2024년부터 제품 발표 주기를 기존 2년에서 1년으로 줄였다. 아마존과 마이크로소프트(MS) 등도 자체 칩을 1년 주기로 내놓고 있다. 구글은 엔비디아 그래픽처리장치(GPU) 사용자가 자사 생태계로 옮길 수 있는 소프트웨어 ‘토치TPU’도 공개했다. AI 개발도구 ‘파이토치’로 만든 AI 모델을 엔비디아의 GPU 최적화 소프트웨어 쿠다(CUDA)가 아닌 TPU 최적화 소프트웨어 토치TPU로 구동할 수 있게 했다. 구글 TPU와 클라우드가 사업에서 커지는 비중은 커지고 있다. 구글 모회사 알파벳의 올해 3분기 클라우드 매출은 307억900만달러로 전년 동기 대비 103% 증가했다. 전체 매출에서 차지하는 비중은 14.8%에서 24.1%로 높아졌다. 알파벳은 기업용 AI 수요와 TPU 시스템 판매가 매출 증가에 기여했다고 밝혔다. 실리콘밸리=김인엽 특파원 inside@hankyung.com

headlines.body: NHN이 인공지능(AI) 그래픽처리장치(GPU) 사업에서 직접비 기준 30%의 이익률을 기록하고 있다고 밝혔다. 또 엔비디아의 최신 GPU B300을 수도권 데이터센터에 추가 구축하고 내년 초부터 가동한다. 안현식 NHN 최고재무책임자(CFO)는 10일 열린 올해 3분기 컨퍼런스콜에서 GPU 사업의 수익성에 대해 "지금까지의 경험치를 바탕으로 보았을 때 30% 가까운 이익이 나오고 있는 상태"라고 말했다. 30% 수익성은 감가상각비 등 전체 비용을 반영한 영업이익률과 다르다. 이어 안 CFO는 "팩토리X에서 기존 B200 GPU를 공급한 데 이어 B300을 도입하면서 최소 양평 팩토리X 수준의 매출을 예상한다"며 "GPU의 세대가 높아질수록 운영 효율성도 개선될 것"이라고 전망했다. 수도권 데이터센터는 NHN클라우드가 서울 가산과 인천 가좌 등 임차 방식으로 추가 확보한다. 김동훈 NHN클라우드 대표는 이날 컨퍼런스콜에서 신규 GPU 인프라 규모에 대해 "수전 용량 기준 6MW 수준"이라며 "B300 기준 1700장을 구축해 12월 말에서 1월 초에 본격 가동할 예정"이라고 말했다. NHN은 해당 데이터센터에서 내년 1월부터 순차 서비스를 시작하고 매출을 인식할 계획이다. 고객사와의 계약 협의도 마무리 단계에 접어들었다고 전했다. 또 NHN클라우드는 내년 정부가 추진할 것으로 예상되는 대규모 GPU 사업에 참여한다. 김 대표는 정부 사업의 방향과 관련해 "내년 정부사업은 4조원 규모로 베라 루빈 이상의 기종을 탑재하는 방향이 될 것으로 예상한다"며 "(NHN도) 사업 참여를 염두에 두고 준비 중"이라고 말했다. 4조원은 NHN클라우드가 예상한 정부 사업 규모다. 베라 루빈(Vera Rubin)은 엔비디아가 개발 중인 차세대 AI 컴퓨팅 플랫폼이다. 데이터센터 운영과 관련해 NHN클라우드는 2027년 말까지 기존 시설을 포함해 총 100MW 규모를 발표했다. 지난 8월 공개한 30MW 추가 확보 계획에 따라 경북 포항 AI데이터센터에 20MW 규모 시설을 임차한다. 광주연구개발특구에는 10MW 규모 자체 데이터센터를 구축한다. 이와 별도로 전남 장성군에 조성 중인 26MW 규모의 '장성파인 AI데이터센터'도 임차할 예정이다. 게임 사업과 관련해 정 대표는 2026년 규제 완화 이후 나타난 웹보드게임의 매출 상승 효과가 내년에도 유지되겠으나 성장세는 둔화할 것으로 전망했다. 정 대표는 "10% 이상 성장률을 담보할 수는 없겠지만 그에 유사한 매출 상승을 목표로 한다"며 한게임 포커 투어 등 오프라인 대회를 통한 홀덤 시장 확대에 집중하겠다"고 말했다. 한편 NHN은 2026년 3분기 연결기준 매출 7583억원, 영업이익 588억원을 기록했다. 전년 동기 대비 각각 21%, 112% 증가한 수치다. 매출과 영업이익 모두 역대 분기 최대 실적이다. 사업별 매출은 기술 부문이 1717억원으로 전년 동기 대비 53% 증가했다. 결제 부문은 3976억원으로 21%, 게임 부문은 1310억원으로 10% 늘었다.

headlines.body: The baying of the hounds can be heard at a distance. Yesterday, Nvidia's Jensen Huang confirmed that it was indeed true that he had a romantic affair with Alice Huang (not related to the family), who U.S. intelligence services claim is a Chinese honeypot tasked with facilitating smuggling of the firm's advanced GPUs into China. Now, a class-action lawsuit and investigations have started flying from almost everywhere. This development is not unexpected, as basic securities law allows shareholders to sue their investees if they misrepresent facts or otherwise perform actions that cause a drop in stock prices. They may have a point, as Nvidia's shares dipped significantly when the confirmation of Jensen's infidelity and the ramifications thereof hit the press everywhere. The legal proceedings are bound to be numerous, but as of right now, the first class-action lawsuit was filed by the Rosen Law Firm. The suit claims that Nvidia and Jensen Huang failed to disclose or misled investors regarding Jensen's affair with Alice, lied about it when asked, raised national security concerns, and caused a subsequent loss of Nvidia's reputation. You can check out the case docket at PacerMonitor here . While legal analysis is beyond the scope of this news, Nvidia did downplay Jensen's relationship with Alice, saying that "Megaspeed has been no different than many other regional cloud customers. Meetings with customers are part of a CEO’s job; Jensen talks with thousands of customer executives every year." Other legal firms have launched their own investigations into the recent development, with essentially the same justification: Schall, Brown & Schwartz attributes a 5.5% pre-market-trading drop to Nvidia, as does Levi & Korsinsky . The office of Frank R. Cruz mentions an 8.8% figure related to intra-day exchanging, and is interested in shareholders with $50,000 in losses. The percentage-drop figure is 5.88% premarket for Bronstein, Gewritz & Grossman . Every investigation and suit mentioned here requires no upfront fees from complainants, as with most class-action lawsuits. The underlying condition is often that the law firms involved get a cut of whichever damages or settlements may appear at the end of the lawsuit. Some of them, like the one by Levi & Korsinsky, even aim to relieve investors who've already sold their Nvidia shares and sold them at a loss, with no minimum amount required.

headlines.body: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has pulled out of the ElevenLabs Summit scheduled for this Wednesday in New York, ElevenLabs, the voice AI company, confirmed Monday. He has also dropped out of other speaking engagements, including the Anthropic CEO Forum. Nvidia is an investor in ElevenLabs. The withdrawals come after Huang admitted to an extramarital affair over the weekend, and Nvidia opened an investigation into his relationship with a possible Chinese spy. “I owe my family and all of you an apology. I was unfaithful to my wife. My actions hurt her and our children. There is no excuse for what I did. I am deeply sorry,” Huang said in a memo to the company. The incident has rattled the AI industry, raising questions about Huang’s staying power as CEO and Nvidia’s own China ambitions.

headlines.body: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's admission of an affair with a purported Chinese spy has raised questions about his future at the company, and what happens if the 63-year-old co-founder, who built the chipmaker into one of the most valuable businesses on the planet, is forced out. Shares of Nvidia sank more than 4% on Monday, even as the broader market rallied sharply, after Huang acknowledged the affair in a message to staff on Sunday, and said that the board was launching an investigation into whether he was targeted by a foreign intelligence agency. The board said it has "confidence in Jensen," and that it has "no reason to believe that either national security or Nvidia secrets were compromised." The New York Times first reported that the Chinese businesswoman was a spy for China's Ministry of State Security, according to people briefed on the intelligence circulated in a memo among the Trump administration in the spring. China has called the allegation a smear. While Nvidia says Huang will continue to lead the company during the probe, pressure is rapidly mounting on the chipmaker, whose technology has powered the first four years of the generative artificial intelligence boom. Leaders from both parties are calling for briefings, and Democrats poised to take control of both houses of Congress are calling for investigations and new legislation "to stop advanced AI chips from fueling China's military," Sen. Elizabeth Warren of Massachusetts wrote in a post on X on Monday. Huang has outsized influence over Nvidia, and is the sole face of the company with no clear second-in-command. He's also among the loudest champions of AI in the country, is critical to the financing of the broader infrastructure buildout and has a close relationship with President Donald Trump, giving Nvidia a front-row seat when it comes to discussions on AI policy, safety and regulation. "The issue at Nvidia is that there is no clear successor to Jensen, and we had expected him to stay in this role for at least 10 more years," analysts at Melius Research said in a Monday research note. Stacy Rasgon, an analyst at Bernstein, told CNBC's "Squawk on the Street" on Monday that, "Jensen is Nvidia. Nvidia is Jensen." He added that Huang "runs the thing pretty much top down," and "sort of pulls all the strings." Nvidia didn't immediately respond to a request for comment. Nvidia has long maintained a flat, non-hierarchical organizational structure. Huang has deep involvement in the company's day-to-day operations and frequently serves as its spokesperson in front of world leaders and at industry conferences. headlines.body: Singapore-based cloud computing company Megaspeed is in the international spotlight after Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang admitted to being unfaithful to his wife, following reports linking him to Megaspeed executive Alice Huang. U.S. intelligence officials believe she is a Chinese intelligence asset, according to The New York Times. While the Nvidia CEO — one of the world's most prominent executives and a figurehead of the AI industry – did not name Megaspeed or Alice Huang in his statement, he acknowledged his infidelity and said Nvidia's Board of Directors had begun an independent investigation "regarding the national security concerns raised in news reports." "I support the investigation and will cooperate fully. I love our country and our company. I am committed to protecting NVIDIA and supporting America's national security. I am proud and grateful to be an American," he said. Nvidia said in a statement it had "no reason to believe that either national security or NVIDIA secrets were compromised," but that its "Board's inquiry will examine all available information." Tech darling Nvidia sells advanced AI and data center chips and has customers including Microsoft, Amazon, Google, Meta and Oracle. The explosion in AI adoption in recent years has fueled its stock and pushed it to a $5 trillion market cap earlier this year. What is Megaspeed? Megaspeed sells services to Asia Pacific-based companies that need large amounts of computing capacity, usually for AI projects, by selling access to computing resources hosted in data centers in Southeast Asia. It advertises itself as a "core business partner" of Nvidia's computing power cloud business in the region, allowing customers to rent computing power from Nvidia GPUs, or "graphics processing units" — specialized chips designed to do many calculations at the same time. The service allows businesses to complete costly AI operations without buying and operating all the hardware themselves. It can also give customers remote access to computing power from advanced chips located outside China. U.S. controls restrict the export of some advanced chips to China, but remote access is a separate question. Megaspeed, which has offices in Singapore and Indonesia, has previously faced media and government scrutiny over whether some of its GPUs have been redirected to China. A report published by Bloomberg in December 2025 stated that the U.S. government was investigating Megaspeed's ownership structure and whether it had smuggled Nvidia chips to China. A response to the article published on Megaspeed's website said it contained "misleading information and incorrect insinuations." It added that inspections by the Bureau of Industry and Security of the U.S. Commerce Department, the Ministry of Investment, Trade and Industry of Malaysia, and Nvidia had found "no evidence of any violations concerning the illicit transfer of chips or any illegal activities." headlines.body: China is building an 800MW AI data center campus in Inner Mongolia that could challenge the economics of America's Stargate project, according to a new report from SemiAnalysis . Envision has built the first 120 MW of Galaxy AI data center campus in less than a year, a cost the researchers put at just one-fifth of comparable US projects, after visiting the site in September. But getting the buildings up is only half of the battle. AI data centers need enormous amounts of electricity, and Envision is taking an unusual route to secure it— building its own wind farms and battery storage alongside the computing facility. While US developers are turning to on-site gas turbines to work around grid constraints, Envision is building its data center alongside wind farms, battery storage, and dedicated power infrastructure. Galaxy is located in Ulanqab, Inner Mongolia, and is being developed across four phases for two unnamed internet companies. The completed campus is planned to provide up to 800MW of IT capacity by the end of 2027, putting it closer to the approximately 820MW of critical IT capacity at the Stargate campus in Abilene, Texas. Envision is building its own power supply for Galaxy rather than leaving everything to the local grid. So far, the company has installed more than 100GW of wind turbines and wants its wind farms to provide over 60% of the electricity needed by the campus’s first two phases. Those farms, located about 80 kilometers apart, have a combined capacity of 420MW. That's well above the 240MW load expected from the first two phases, although wind turbines rarely get to run flat out. Ulanqab’s wind capacity factor is between 355 and 40%, so Envision is adding four-hour battery storage to keep the electricity coming when the wind dies down. (Image credit: SemiAnalysis) Power equipment is proving rather hard to come by for some US data center builders. We have previously reported on turbine shortages that have pushed delivery estimates to 2030, while SpaceX is looking to manufacture its own turbine blades for its gas-powered AI facilities. Envision, meanwhile, is putting wind generation and battery storage right alongside its servers. The power hardware inside the Galaxy is worth a look, too. Semianalyss visited a 5MW hall where solid-state transformers take 10kV AC electricity and convert it directly into 800V DC for the server racks. That's a fairly substantial departure from conventional data-center power distribution, which typically involves several intermediate conversion stages. “In one 5MW hall, we saw the 800V system at work,” the researchers wrote. They explained that “Solid-state transformers (SSTs) take 10kV AC from the grid and convert it straight to 800V DC for the racks.” The design removes several intermediate components found in conventional data center power systems, including low voltage transformers, uninterruptible power supplies and rectifiers. Securities lawyers were already moving. At least four firms, including Schall, Brown & Schwartz and Levi & Korsinsky, announced investigations Monday into whether Nvidia misled investors. Robert Bartlett, a Stanford Law professor and securities law expert, expects them to have plenty of company. “I would definitely wager that there’ll be a filing,” Bartlett said in an interview Monday morning, adding that he wouldn’t be surprised if a case had been filed by the end of the day. Plaintiffs’ lawyers have good reasons to be first in line; under federal securities law, the first complaint triggers a public notice, and investors then have 60 days to ask the court to be named lead plaintiff. A firm that files early gets a head start on signing up investors with large losses, as well as on shaping the story of the case. Bartlett was right, in fact. A case surfaced Monday afternoon in the Northern District of California, where Nvidia is headquartered. Rosen Law Firm, a New York-based plaintiffs’ firm that specializes in securities class actions, filed it on behalf of Mark Kistenmacher, a retail investor who made seven purchases totaling roughly $20,500 this year, according to a schedule attached to the complaint. (Rosen was lead counsel in a $250 million settlement with Alibaba and ranks among the most active filers of such cases.) The proposed class covers anyone who bought Nvidia securities between Oct. 9, 2025, and Nov. 8, 2026, and the suit names both Nvidia and Huang. The complaint accuses them of misleading investors about Huang’s ties to Megaspeed, the Singapore-based data center outfit where Alice Huang was considered a top exec, and it points to three statements as proof: Nvidia spokesperson John Rizzo’s late-October claim that Huang’s interactions with Alice Huang were “not unusual or unexpected,” the company’s even earlier claim that it found “no evidence of diversion” of its chips, and Jensen Huang’s Oct. 30 comment to Bloomberg that Nvidia’s dealings with Megaspeed were “normal and not unusual.” All three were false or misleading, the suit says, because Huang was having an affair with Alice Huang. Kistenmacher is asking for unspecified damages, interest and attorneys’ fees, and he wants a jury trial. headlines.body: After a tumultuous month for neoclouds that saw stock prices cut in half, investors are eager to hear how the leading companies in the space plan to navigate a tightening credit market and an unfavorable political environment. CoreWeave is set to report quarterly results on Tuesday, followed by Nebius on Thursday. Both companies are reliant on debt to fund their purchases of cutting-edge artificial intelligence systems, but they're confronting a skeptical base of lenders as the AI trade sours on Wall Street. The neoclouds had a particularly rough day last Thursday, suffering dramatic drops and contributing to the Nasdaq's steepest slump in 19 months. Leading chipmakers Nvidia, Advanced Micro Devices and Micron also plummeted on concern that raging anti-AI sentiment would further complicate buildout plans. Nvidia, a major investor in a number of neoclouds, including CoreWeave and Nebius, faces its own fresh turbulence after CEO Jensen Huang admitted Sunday that he'd had an extramarital affair with a business executive who intelligence agencies say is a Chinese spy. That news could add further volatility to an already nervous market. Democrats last week won governors' races in Georgia, Iowa, Nevada, Ohio and Texas, and voters rejected data centers in all but one of the 41 related measures on ballots across the country. CoreWeave CEO Mike Intrator took to LinkedIn to try to temper investors' fears. "We currently don't anticipate any impact to CoreWeave's existing customer commitments or associated backlog as a result of shifts in the political landscape," Intrator wrote. But the market was unrelenting. Yields on some CoreWeave bonds maturing in 2031 jumped above 16%. The spread on its five-year credit default swaps, which are insurance against default, soared above 1,240 basis points, up 50% in the past month. "I do agree completely that neoclouds in particular are going to be the most impacted," Anastasia Amoroso, chief investment strategist at Partners Group, told CNBC's "Closing Bell" on Friday. Unlike hyperscalers Amazon and Microsoft, the top neoclouds are unprofitable and heavily dependent on a small number of customers. IREN, a smaller publicly traded neocloud, said in its earnings report late Thursday that about 48% of its backlog was tied to Microsoft. But the company provided some relief to the market after reporting that AI cloud revenue more than doubled from the prior period. IREN's stock jumped 20% on Friday, recouping its losses from Thursday. Daniel Roberts, co-CEO of IREN, told CNBC that there's a "disconnect between what we're seeing in public market and what we're seeing at the customer level," but he acknowledged the challenge posed by financial markets. headlines.body: AI 추천 뉴스 몸집 키우는 AI 인프라 유통사…서버·GPU 입도선매 주문 쏟아져 기업 수요에 총판사들 초호황 코오롱베니트, 연매출 1조 예상 에티버스는 2조 돌파 가능성 다올티에스도 영업이익 급증 국내 인공지능(AI) 수요가 급증하면서 그래픽처리장치(GPU) 서버·소프트웨어 등 AI 인프라 유통시장도 빠르게 커지고 있다. 시스템통합(SI) 업체와 통신사, 포털 등이 AI 데이터센터 투자를 확대하는 가운데 IT·금융·제조업 등 다양한 분야 기업도 자체 AI 시스템 구축과 클라우드 이용을 늘리면서다. 일부 AI 인프라 유통기업은 올해 매출이 전년의 두 배에 육박할 거란 전망도 나온다. 9일 업계에 따르면 그래픽처리장치(GPU) 탑재 서버와 소프트웨어 등 AI 인프라를 유통하는 코오롱베니트의 올 상반기 매출은 4422억원으로 전년 동기(2478억원) 대비 78.5% 급증했다. 지난해 매출 5481억원의 약 80%를 상반기에 채운 것으로, 1673억원에서 3517억원으로 두 배 이상 증가한 ‘IT 유통’ 부문 매출이 성장을 이끌었다. 업계에선 코오롱베니트가 올해 사상 최초로 연 매출 1조원을 돌파할 가능성이 높은 것으로 보고 있다. 코오롱베니트를 비롯해 에티버스그룹, 다올티에스 등 ‘총판사’들은 해외 제조 GPU 탑재 서버, 클라우드 플랫폼 등 AI 소프트웨어를 국내에 유통하고 있다. 한국델테크놀로지스, 휴렛팩커드엔터프라이즈(HPE), 슈퍼마이크로 등 서버 제조업체가 AI 서버를 국내에 수입하면 이를 데이터센터 수요 기업에 공급하는 방식이다. 수천 곳의 판매·기술지원 협력사(리셀러)들과 협업해 유지·보수·관리 역할도 한다. 기업들의 AI 도입 확대가 데이터센터 투자와 서버·소프트웨어 구매 증가로 이어지고 있는 것이다. 한 서버 제조업체 관계자는 “GPU 탑재 서버를 일단 확보하려는 입도선매식 주문이 쏟아지고 있다”며 “수십 년 업계에 있었지만 이런 업황은 처음 겪는다”고 혀를 내둘렀다. SK텔레콤, 삼성SDS, LG CNS, 네이버 등 데이터센터 구축 수요와 이를 임대하려는 IT, 금융, 제조업 등 다양한 수요가 폭발하고 있다는 설명이다. 이에 따라 에티버스그룹, 다올티에스 등 다른 총판사들의 실적도 급증세인 것으로 전해졌다. 업계에선 2024년 매출 1조3692억원을 올렸던 에티버스그룹의 올해 매출이 2조원을 돌파할 것으로 보고 있다. HPE의 서버, 레드햇의 소프트웨어 등 AI 인프라를 유통하는 에티버스그룹은 올해 3월 코람코자산신탁이 서울 숭례문 에티버스타워(옛 롯데손해보험 사옥)를 2647억원에 사들이는 거래에서 인수 리츠의 최대주주로 참여하기도 했다. 델테크놀로지스의 국내 최대 총판사인 다올티에스 영업이익은 2024년 35억원에서 지난해 61억원으로 급증했다. 기업들의 AI 수요가 급증한 올해 실적은 더 좋아질 거란 전망이다. 한 총판사 관계자는 “총판사와 최종 고객사 사이에서 2차 유통과 사후 관리를 맡는 리셀러 업체 중에서도 1~2년 사이 매출이 두 배 증가한 곳이 많다”고 귀띔했다. 시장이 커지자 인근 업종 기업들도 뛰어들고 있다. 클라우드 관리 서비스(MSP)가 주력인 메가존클라우드는 지난해 11월 엔비디아와 총판 계약을 맺고 AI 인프라 공급 사업에 나섰다. 업계 관계자는 “국내 기업의 AI 도입 속도가 빨라 시장은 앞으로도 꾸준히 성장할 것으로 전망한다”며 “다만 4~5%를 넘기 힘든 영업이익률은 과제”라고 말했다. 박한신 기자 phs@hankyung.com
